import json
import numpy as np

with open('shots/train.json') as f:
    train = json.load(f)

h = train['header']
print(len(train['shots']), 'arcs')
keys = ['sample_rate_hz', 'record_begins', 'record_ends', 'rim_height_m',
        'hoop_inner_radius_m', 'ball_radius_m']
for key in keys:
    print(key, ':', h[key])
print('vertical noise (m) :', h['tracking_noise']['vertical_m'])

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

s = train['shots'][0]
t = np.array(s['t'])
z = np.array(s['z'])
# vertical speed: central difference two frames each side
vz = (z[4:] - z[:-4]) / (t[4:] - t[:-4])

fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 1, sharex=True)
ax1 = axes[0]
ax2 = axes[1]
ax1.plot(t, z, '.')
ax1.set_ylabel('height (m)')
ax1.set_title(f"Arc {s['id']}: height and vertical speed")
ax2.plot(t[2:-2], vz, '.-')
ax2.set_ylabel('vertical speed (m/s)')
ax2.set_xlabel('time from first frame (s)')
plt.show()

for s in train['shots']:
    if s['id'] == 325:
        break                 # s is now arc 325
t = np.array(s['t'])
z = np.array(s['z'])
print(np.round(np.diff(z[22:47]), 4))

plt.plot(t, z, '.-')
plt.xlabel('time from first frame (s)')
plt.ylabel('height (m)')
plt.title('Arc 325, height')
plt.show()

g_all = []
ids = []
for s in train['shots']:
    if s['id'] == 325:
        continue
    t, z, r, end = flight(s)
    g_all.append(-2*fit_free(t, z)[2])
    ids.append(s['id'])
g_all = np.array(g_all)
print(len(g_all), 'arcs')
sd = np.std(g_all, ddof=1)       # ddof=1: the sample standard deviation
print(f'mean {np.mean(g_all):.2f}  sd {sd:.2f}')
print(f'min {np.min(g_all):.2f}  max {np.max(g_all):.2f}')

plt.hist(g_all, bins=8)
plt.axvline(9.81, color='k', linestyle='--', label='9.81')
plt.xlabel('g fitted to the whole flight (m/s²)')
plt.ylabel('number of arcs')
plt.title('Gravity fitted to each whole flight, 23 arcs')
plt.legend()
plt.show()

fit_f = []
fit_x = []
out_f = []
out_x = []
for s in train['shots']:
    if s['id'] == 325:
        continue
    t, z, r, end = flight(s)
    half = len(t) // 2
    tf = t[:half]            # first half, fitted
    zf = z[:half]
    tp = t[half:]            # second half, unseen
    zp = z[half:]
    cf = fit_free(tf, zf)
    cx = fit_fixed(tf, zf)
    fit_f.append(rms_cm(cf, tf, zf))
    fit_x.append(rms_cm(cx, tf, zf))
    out_f.append(rms_cm(cf, tp, zp))
    out_x.append(rms_cm(cx, tp, zp))
fit_f = np.array(fit_f)
fit_x = np.array(fit_x)
out_f = np.array(out_f)
out_x = np.array(out_x)

m = []
for x in (fit_f, fit_x, out_f, out_x):
    m.append(np.median(x))
print(f'first half (fitted), median rms:   free {m[0]:.2f}  fixed {m[1]:.2f}')
print(f'   free smaller or equal on {np.sum(fit_f <= fit_x)} of {len(fit_f)}')
print(f'second half (unseen), median rms:  free {m[2]:.1f}  fixed {m[3]:.1f}')
print(f'   fixed smaller on {np.sum(out_x < out_f)} of {len(out_f)}')
print(f'   worst: free {np.max(out_f):.1f}  fixed {np.max(out_x):.1f}')

plt.loglog(out_x, out_f, 'o')
plt.plot([1, 100], [1, 100], 'k--', label='equal error')
plt.xlabel('gravity held at 9.81: rms error on 2nd half (cm)')
plt.ylabel('gravity fitted: rms error on 2nd half (cm)')
plt.title('Each arc fitted on its first half, scored on its second')
plt.legend()
plt.show()
